expect_red: an assembly whose rows fall in more than one body is bracketed once per run of them, inside each body and under its own name, and a fold folds every run

mutations.contract: An assembly's run of rows is cut at a body bracket's edge, so where both are drawn an assembly in two bodies is one bracket inside each.
mutations.note: Runs that ignore the body: the link assembly's bracket runs from ground through the link into the arm, across three body brackets it is no longer inside.
